what: THE FAILURE: PR #10923 was green and mergeable at 11:01:05Z and merged at 11:11Z. Ten minutes. The OPERATOR noticed before any mechanism did; the manager's own 11:04Z sweep timer trig_016Tn8Kt9sDtQHhxG9NKQabT was `enabled` with `next_run_at: 11:04:00Z` and NEVER FIRED -- no error, no log, no observable state change.
